WITH corte AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch)::date AS f FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (

  WHERE v.vta_fch::date BETWEEN c.f - 29 AND c.f
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (

)
SELECT a.art_cd AS sku
FROM artmst a
JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
WHERE a.art_crt = true
  AND COALESCE(v.und30, 0) > 0
  AND COALESCE(s.stock_total, 0) / (COALESCE(v.und30, 0) / 30.0) < p.prv_dte
ORDER BY a.art_cd

WITH f AS (SELECT MAX(vta_fch) AS fmax FROM vtadia),
ventas AS (

  FROM vtadia v, f
  WHERE v.vta_fch BETWEEN f.fmax - 29 AND f.fmax
  GROUP BY v.vta_art
),
stock AS (
  SELECT exi_art, SUM(COALESCE(exi_qty,0)) AS stock_total
  FROM exidet GROUP BY exi_art
),
cedis AS (
  SELECT alm_id FROM almmst WHERE alm_dsc LIKE 'CEDIS%'
),
riesgo AS (
  SELECT a.art_cd
  FROM artmst a
  JOIN prvmst p ON p.prv_id = a.art_prv
  JOIN ventas v ON v.vta_art = a.art_cd
  LEFT JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = a.art_cd
  WHERE a.art_crt = true
    AND v.und30 > 0
    AND COALESCE(s.stock_total,0) / (v.und30 / 30.0) < p.prv_dte
),
excedente AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.exi_art
  FROM exidet e
  JOIN stock s ON s.exi_art = e.exi_art
  WHERE e.exi_alm IN (SELECT alm_id FROM cedis)
    AND s.stock_total > 0
    AND COALESCE(e.exi_qty,0) > 1.5 * (s.stock_total / 3.0)

FROM riesgo r
